body:
https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/issues/8080#issuecomment-92953426

directly on MySQL:

``` sql
CREATE TABLE test (
    created_at TIMESTAMP, 
    updated_at TIMESTAMP
);

show create table test;
```

```
CREATE TABLE `test` (
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT '0000-00-00 00:00:00'
)
```

@alchimik 
Any idea on how to avoid this problem?

That makes sense, but maybe Yii should set the `'NULL DEFAULT NULL'` if no default is specified in the `createTable`.
As a lot of people will be using MySQL with Yii it makes more sense to avoid these problems to future users (or at least put some note somewhere).
We have messed up a big project because of this problem.
@githubjeka thanks. But I do not think this is a yii issue, see: https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/issues/9343#issuecomment-188925372

Okay, now I see, this test fails:

``` diff
diff --git a/tests/framework/db/ColumnSchemaBuilderTest.php b/tests/framework/db/ColumnSchemaBuilderTest.php
index 1f79721..72448a8 100644
--- a/tests/framework/db/ColumnSchemaBuilderTest.php
+++ b/tests/framework/db/ColumnSchemaBuilderTest.php
@@ -66,4 +66,10 @@ class ColumnSchemaBuilderTest extends TestCase

         self::assertEquals($expected, $builder->__toString());
     }
+
+    public function testMySQLTimestamp()
+    {
+        $timestampColumn = (string) $this->getColumnSchemaBuilder(Schema::TYPE_TIMESTAMP)->defaultValue(null);
+        $this->assertEquals('TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL', $timestampColumn);
+    }
 }
```

```
4) yiiunit\framework\db\pgsql\ColumnSchemaBuilderTest::testMySQLTimestamp
Failed asserting that two strings are equal.
--- Expected
+++ Actual
@@ @@
-'TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL'
+'timestamp'
```
